rulings.model: This fits the Form 1040 income lines shown: 1b–1d and 1f–1h are screened, and 1e is left to Form 2441 ('Taxable dependent care benefits from Form 2441, line 26'). Nonresident alien status and passive-activity rules aren't in the text given. Line 1i, 'Nontaxable combat pay election', isn't named and is covered only by the general phrase 'other … return treatment'.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: unclear for want of text; restatement accepted. A filer-answered scope question; the model found its income items consistent with Form 1040 lines 1b to 1h, line 1e being left to Form 2441 ("Taxable dependent care benefits from Form 2441, line 26"). Line 1i needs no mention here: it is the nontaxable combat pay election for the EIC (i1040gi p. 25, Line 1i, "If you elect to include your nontaxable combat pay in your earned income when figuring the EIC, enter the amount on line 1i"), and any nontaxable combat pay is refused through s8812.combat_pay (on eic.step5_line4, Schedule 8812 line 18b and Form 2441 lines 4, 5, 18 and 19), so line 1i is never above zero. Nonresident alien status and passive activities are refusals recorded in spec 2.1. No change.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: second construction right in part; proposed finding (the same as on schedule1; wording of a refusal; no value changes). The married filing separately refusal matches the text, as the model says (i1040gi p. 14, Married Filing Separately). The other refusals are filer-answered declarations whose items are cited on the lines that read them (unclear for want of text; accepted). But the refusal text shown for a Yes, under scope.ready and on Form 1040 lines 8 and 10 (scope.yaml; f1040.line8 and line10), still reads "Schedule 1 income and adjustments other than unemployment compensation, educator expenses, the HSA deduction and student loan interest are outside this tool", which leaves out the items the question itself carves out as supported (business income or loss from Schedule C, the deductible part of self-employment tax, self-employed SEP and SIMPLE contributions, the self-employed health insurance deduction). Proposed fix: the remedy names the same supported items as the question. Recorded as BUG-0081 and TASKS.md T-050; the wording is corrected there, with the reviews of scope and f1040 rerun after.

rulings.restated: Input — Any income or adjustment requiring Schedule 1 other than business income or loss from Schedule C, unemployment compensation, educator expenses, the HSA deduction, the deductible part of self-employment tax, self-employed SEP and SIMPLE contributions, the self-employed health insurance deduction and student loan interest, including a taxable state or local tax refund; alimony; an IRA deduction; statutory-employee wages or clergy income; church employee income (wages from a church that elected exemption from social security and Medicare taxes); other qualified retirement plans for the self-employed (such as a solo 401(k) or other Keogh plan); rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, estates or trusts (Schedule E or a Schedule K-1); rental of personal property; farm income (Schedule F); gambling winnings, prizes or other income for Schedule 1 line 8; or an exclusion of Medicaid waiver payments (Schedule 1 line 8s)? (Schedule 1-A deductions are asked separately.)
rulings.model: The Form 1040 text only says line 8 is 'Additional income from Schedule 1, line 10' and line 10 is 'Adjustments to income from Schedule 1, line 26'. The Schedule 1 line items this question carves out or lists, such as Schedule C, line 8s and alimony, aren't in the text given. Note that the question treats Schedule C income, the SE tax deduction, SEP/SIMPLE and SE health insurance as supported, but the matching refusal says everything except unemployment compensation, educator expenses, the HSA deduction and student loan interest is outside the tool.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: second construction right in part; proposed finding (wording of a refusal; no value changes). The question is filer-answered and its list of supported items matches what the project computes; the Schedule 1 lines it names are cited by the lines that read them, not by the question, and Form 1040 line 8, "Additional income from Schedule 1, line 10", and line 10, "Adjustments to income from Schedule 1, line 26" (f1040 (2025), lines 8 and 10), are all the given text shows (unclear for want of text; restatement accepted, as the prior ruling). The model's note is right: the refusal text shown for a Yes, under scope.ready and on Form 1040 lines 8 and 10 (scope.yaml; f1040.line8 and line10), still reads "Schedule 1 income and adjustments other than unemployment compensation, educator expenses, the HSA deduction and student loan interest are outside this tool", which leaves out the items the question itself carves out as supported (business income or loss from Schedule C, the deductible part of self-employment tax, self-employed SEP and SIMPLE contributions, the self-employed health insurance deduction). A filer told the refusal would read Schedule C income as outside the tool. Proposed fix: the remedy names the same supported items as the question. Recorded as BUG-0081 and TASKS.md T-050; the wording is corrected there, with the reviews of scope and f1040 rerun after.
